title: Market Observatory end-to-end architecture audit — independent ROY review
scope: Public Market Observatory only, not private Control Tower accounts or live trading
areas: P0 source provenance, Yahoo monthly/quarterly bar look-ahead in TRI-POD signal replay; distinguish signal vs backtest vs UI
P0 collection-date and trading-session semantics: US/KR/JP FX rates, VIX close vs equity close, 24/7 crypto, market calendar, daily historical bars
P0 concurrent GitHub Actions writes, workflow_run chains, lock group mismatches and atomic multi-file publication
P1 publication assurance: main branch commit vs Pages deployed JSON vs live quotes endpoint; health/receipt provenance and generated_at freshness
P1 reliability and spend: number of workflows, cron overlap, redundant triggers, retries, watchdog, API rate limits, Pages build noise
P1 UI performance and mobile usability: loads, large files, long history on-demand, shared state, JS modules/chart rendering, touch interaction
P1 data observability: live vs stale and expected-session gates, independent source evidence, dashboards, alert quality
P2 architecture/maintainability: static Pages architecture vs API, refactoring to stable units, code ownership, testing, versioned schemas
acceptance: Provide independently grounded severity P0/P1/P2 and concrete code path and line evidence, risk, remedial design and tests.
Clearly distinguish verified current bug, exposure/risk hypothesis, and unverified claim. Identify any false alarm in JJOONI findings.
Critique 47 workflow files, 31 root Observatory data entries, main-heavy output, short/long read paths and cost impact without inventing billing.
Trace 3 complete flows: (a) completed US close to published strategy UI, (b) crypto quote refreshed to live UI, (c) official macro calendar release to EOD date.
Provide top 5 quick wins (no prod change in this task) and 3 structural proposals with rollback/migration strategy.
Propose a limited regression test matrix, architecture contract, acceptance criteria and safe implementation staging.
Post exactly one GitHub top-level PR comment prefixed by exact one-line marker, then summary PASS/BLOCKED/NEEDS_DATA and source evidence.
forbidden: Any code modification or branch push
Changing data pipelines or published JSON
Cloud Run, paid model API keys, paid background infrastructure
Reading or publishing credentials, private account or customer data
Asserting unattended event trigger without independently available run metadata
